correctness.rationale: For each coordinate projection the generic fiber is the blowup of a smooth quadric at two distinct points, and only t=0/infty can be singular. At t=0 the actual blown-up total-space chart has fiber equation z²=u²v. Its Jacobian locus is the full exceptional P1, generically double normal crossing with one Whitney pinch point in each of two blowup charts. The finite birational morphism from the quadric cone minimal resolution F2 gives normalization; conductor maps the negative section 2:1 ramified at two points. Symmetry proves all four special fiber statements. Euler 4 by normalization/conductor, independently e(X)=8 by threefold blowup and base stratification; exact symbolic identities replayed.
